description: Convenience: list the most recent HM Land Registry property sales for a single UK postcode (England & Wales). Returns sale price (£GBP), date, address, property type, tenure and new-build flag, newest sale first. Postcode must be UPPERCASE with a space, e.g. "SW1A 1AA".

postcode.description: UK postcode, UPPERCASE with a space, e.g. "WA2 8SN".

name: lookup_postcode
